recent_excerpts: FBI arrested CyberSteward co-founder Edward Dubrovsky on cyber extortion charges tied to ShinyHunters, the group that stole data on thousands of FBI agents.
iRhythm says a June social engineering attack exposed names, insurance numbers, and device serials for 360,000 patients across Texas, South Carolina, and California.
FBI arrested a Canadian national in Pennsylvania, its third ShinyHunters arrest in two weeks, after the group breached FBIjobs.gov and stole data on nearly every FBI employee.
